conclusion: Core substantive content is preserved in all 40 localizations, including market/powertrain/trim scope and safety limitations. Three medium semantic/scope findings were corrected and verified with parent authorization. No unresolved material factual, safety, invented-test or unsupported numerical-specification issue identified in this review. Seventeen low-severity copyedit/typography suggestions remain, including two metadata descriptions; these do not constitute publication approval.
research_limitations: Compared supplied fact-sheet allowances and identity/conflict boundaries; did not independently reopen every external source in this language-review task.
No native-speaker human approval or physical vehicle/child-seat/repair testing.

Portuguese is regionally mixed across articles: most use European Portuguese, while TIGGO 9 and puncture handover use Brazilian vocabulary such as porta-malas and estepe. User requested generic Portuguese without a region, so this is an editorial consistency limitation, not a translation error or blocker.
No image wording assessment because parent is aligning ALT and captions centrally.

Localized prose is sometimes condensed and FAQ wording differs, but full reads found no omitted substantive decision/safety boundary. Exact source freshness and publish authorization belong to the lead workflow.

per_topic_findings.aion-v: Whole Premium Pack v1.3 retained in all four languages: genuine leather, front massage, second-row tray, CoolHot Box and PM2.5 sensor. Standard seat heating/ventilation, steering-wheel and rear-seat heating remain separate. No unsupported health, food-storage or quality claims. The no-numeric-spec FAQ is replaced by an additional package FAQ, but its rationale remains in every body.
per_topic_findings.chery-tiggo-9: Seven-seat UK Summit PHEV/AWD identity, opposing third-row reviews, passenger/loading trials, control evaluation and UK-only RAC support scope preserved. No disputed luggage figures inserted.
per_topic_findings.jaecoo-5: UK petrol Pure/Luxury kept separate from E5 and SHS-S. Dealer feature statements remain provisional; old Luxury test not misrepresented as Pure test. Camera/heated-steering uncertainty and export-warranty caveat preserved.
per_topic_findings.omoda-9: Black Noble styling separated from MY26 comfort revisions; older reviews not applied as proof of revised ride. Conflicting power/torque values excluded; Euro NCAP applicability and export support caveats retained.
per_topic_findings.zeekr-7x: Current Swedish Core/Long Range RWD and Privilege AWD identity retained. Air suspension and optional powered doors distinguished; German test-car equipment not treated as Swedish standard. Legacy trims, numeric specs and assessment applicability remain limited.
per_topic_findings.air-conditioning-serviceability: Actual label, refrigerant and oil identity, DENSO-specific ND-oil 11, possible special PAG applications, qualified workshop route and EPA jurisdiction limits preserved. No DIY charging/mixing quantities or universal EV-POE rule introduced.
per_topic_findings.child-seat-position-compatibility: Exact restraint/base/vehicle/position, both manuals, tether versus luggage anchor, both-manufacturer permission for combining methods, Fit Finder limitations and trained combined trial retained. No three-across guarantee or universal child age/weight law introduced.
per_topic_findings.headlamp-beam-compatibility: Steering position, temporary adaptation, technical adjustment and registration acceptance remain separate. V60 2021, GB MOT, Northern Ireland conditions and NT personally imported light-vehicle scope retained; no universal retrofit promise.
per_topic_findings.petrol-octane-ethanol-compatibility: Octane versus ethanol, RON/AKI notation, required versus recommended, E15 10.5–15% US context, E85 flex-fuel boundary, market-specific checkers and DN8 2027 en_US document identity preserved. No universal conversion or premium benefit inserted.
per_topic_findings.puncture-kit-handover: Exact kit/spare identity, component inspection without consuming sealant, expiry, compatible replacement, temporary limits and secure storage preserved. No universal speed/distance/repair-size limit or permanent-repair claim inserted.

findings.before: El fabricante sueco las indica como opción.
findings.recommended_fix: La página sueca del fabricante las indica como opción.

findings.before: Elles ne prouvent pas la compatibilité constructeur d’une voiture chinoise, d’un moteur destiné à un autre marché ou de toutes les voitures importées.
findings.recommended_fix: Elles ne prouvent pas la compatibilité constructeur d’un véhicule destiné au marché chinois, d’un moteur destiné à un autre marché ou de toutes les voitures importées.
findings.reason: Preserve China-market scope, rather than recasting it as national origin of the vehicle. Applied with parent authorization.

findings.before: No prueban que un producto sea adecuado para un vehículo sin identificar ni para todos los productos de una marca.
findings.recommended_fix: Estas fuentes no demuestran que una silla concreta sea compatible con un vehículo sin identificar ni que un resultado obtenido para un producto se aplique a otros de la misma marca.
findings.reason: The original second clause incorrectly compared a product’s suitability with other products; the EN warning concerns extending a compatibility result to other products. Applied with parent authorization.

findings.before: Sie verrät noch nicht, ob Ihnen die Bedienung liegt, Ihr übliches Gepäck bequem hineinpasst oder die Gasannahme zu Ihren Strecken passt.
